---
title: "City data"
---


```{r}
#| echo: false
#| message: false
#| warning: false

library(DT)
library(dplyr)

source("helpers.R")

dat <- read.csv("intermediates/final_dat.csv")


fancy_dt(dat[c("ID", "Ticks", "year", "ArticleTitle", "city")], 
         options = list(
    pageLength = 50,
    dom = "Bfrtip",
    buttons = c("copy", "csv"),
    columnDefs = list(
      list(targets = 0, render = render_publication),
      list(targets = 4, visible = FALSE)
    ),
    initComplete = JS("
      function(settings, json) {
        const params = new URLSearchParams(window.location.search);
        
        let city = decodeURIComponent(window.location.search.substring(1));
        
        if (city) {
          $('h1.title').text('Publications from ' + city);
          document.title = 'Publications from ' + city;
          
          var api = this.api();
          api.column(4).search('^' + $.fn.dataTable.util.escapeRegex(city) + '$', true, false).draw();
        } 
      }
    ")))

```
